notes: 30 tasks, stable ordering. To use the real τ²-Bench tasks, clone the repo to eval/tau2 and let eval/harness.py import tau2_bench. This file is the fallback manifest used by the mock runner so the dev loop works offline.

tasks.prompt: Check order status for an existing customer and refund if eligible.
Cancel an order within the cancellation window.
Exchange item for a different size; verify stock.
Apply a promo code and recompute total.
Return an already-shipped item and generate return label.
Split a payment across two cards.
Reset password with email verification.
Update shipping address on a pending order.
Check store pickup availability for a product.
Loyalty-points redemption on a partial order.
Gift-card balance lookup and partial use.
Backorder handling: item arrives late, offer alternative.
Warranty claim: verify eligibility, open RMA.
International shipping quote with duties estimate.
Bundle discount eligibility and application.
Refund declined — route to specialist with reason.
Item marked hazmat — surface shipping restriction.
Customer has fraud flag — hold action pending review.
Multi-item partial refund with tax recomputation.
Dual-control refund over threshold — request approver.
Subscription pause for 30 days, resume automatically.
Replace misdelivered item with expedited ship.
Price match competitor link within 14 days.
Return window expired — offer store credit alternative.
Customer profile merge from two duplicate accounts.
Shipping carrier misquote — recompute with correct weight.
Verify delivery address against USPS and update.
Loyalty tier upgrade: confirm benefits and apply.
Cart recovery: apply saved discount on checkout.
Resolve payment auth failure and retry.
